description: This file is a PHP template used for rendering a documentation page with dynamic content such as title, breadcrumbs, modification date, edit link, page content, and navigation links.

classes.name: Todaymade\Daux\FormatDate
classes.description: A class responsible for formatting date values, used here to display modification date.

methods.name: get_breadcrumb_title
methods.description: Retrieves the breadcrumb title for the page, used in the header.

methods.name: showDateModified
methods.description: Checks whether to display the modified date based on configuration.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a human-readable date string.

methods.name: getEditOn
methods.description: Retrieves the URL and name for the 'Edit on' link if available.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a given string key into the appropriate language.
